source: UCI Machine Learning Repository — Iris dataset
source_note: The Iris dataset is public. To demonstrate data cleaning, several data-quality defects were deliberately introduced into a practice copy; these injected defects are documented in README.md.
cleaning_steps: Trimmed whitespace and standardized species labels
Converted numeric measurements to numeric types
Converted missing markers and non-numeric entries to missing values
Flagged measurements outside 0.1 to 10 cm as missing
Corrected the documented species spelling variant 'versicolour' to 'versicolor'
Imputed missing measurements with the median for the same species
note: Median imputation is a demonstration choice. In a real project, confirm imputation rules with a domain expert.
